title: Ujian Kelulusan A1.1: Evaluasi Fondasi 4 Keterampilan
objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level A1.2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan ini mengevaluasi pemahaman menyeluruh Anda terhadap dasar-dasar bahasa Inggris level A1.1. Anda akan diuji dalam 4 keterampilan utama: mendengarkan (listening), membaca (reading), menulis (writing), dan berbicara (speaking). Materi mencakup negara dan kebangsaan, kata kerja to be, keluarga, rutinitas harian, makanan dan minuman, waktu, can/can't, tempat di kota, dan past simple was/were. Jawablah setiap pertanyaan dengan teliti dan percaya diri!
rules: Listening Comprehension: Dengarkan audio dengan saksama dan pahami konteks percakapan untuk menjawab pertanyaan tentang informasi spesifik
Reading Comprehension: Baca teks pendek dengan cermat dan identifikasi detail penting seperti nama, tempat, waktu, dan aktivitas
Writing & Grammar: Gunakan struktur kalimat yang benar dengan to be (am/is/are/was/were), can/can't, dan simple present/past tense
Speaking & Situational Dialogue: Pilih respons yang paling natural dan sopan sesuai konteks situasi percakapan sehari-hari

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa terburu-buru membaca soal tanpa memperhatikan detail kecil seperti bentuk kata kerja (was/were, is/are) atau penggunaan can/can't. Perhatikan juga subjek kalimat untuk menentukan to be yang tepat.
commonTrap.wrong: She were at the library yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: She was at the library yesterday.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang BENAR dan terhindar dari jebakan kesalahan umum pada topik "Evaluasi Fondasi 4 Keterampilan"?
options: She was at the library yesterday
She were at the library yesterday
She were at the library yesterday
readinessQuestions.explanation: Banyak siswa terburu-buru membaca soal tanpa memperhatikan detail kecil seperti bentuk kata kerja (was/were, is/are) atau penggunaan can/can't. Perhatikan juga subjek kalimat untuk menentukan to be yang tepat.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
Lisa: "That's nice! Where is your cousin from?"
Marco: "[...]"
options: He's from Italy, but he lives here now. He can speak three languages!
Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
She were at the library yesterday
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "He's from Italy, but he lives here now. He can speak three languages!" ("Dia dari Italia, tapi sekarang tinggal di sini. Dia bisa berbicara tiga bahasa!") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Marco.

vocab.collocation: What is your nationality? I'm Indonesian.
My daily routine starts at 6 a.m.
I go to the market every Saturday morning.
I usually have eggs and toast for breakfast.

dialogue.context: Lisa bertemu dengan temannya Marco di kafe. Mereka berbincang tentang keluarga dan rencana akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Hi Marco! How are you today?
lines.translation: Hai Marco! Apa kabar hari ini?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I'm great, thanks! I was at my cousin's house yesterday. It was fun!
lines.translation: Aku baik, terima kasih! Aku kemarin di rumah sepupuku. Menyenangkan!

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: That's nice! Where is your cousin from?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Dari mana sepupumu berasal?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: He's from Italy, but he lives here now. He can speak three languages!
lines.translation: Dia dari Italia, tapi sekarang tinggal di sini. Dia bisa berbicara tiga bahasa!

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Wow! That's amazing. What are you doing this weekend?
lines.translation: Wah! Itu luar biasa. Apa rencanamu akhir pekan ini?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I'm going to the new restaurant near the park. Do you want to come?
lines.translation: Aku akan ke restoran baru dekat taman. Kamu mau ikut?

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Yes, I'd love to! What time?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: How about 7 o'clock in the evening?

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kegiatan sehari-hari dan keluarga Anda. Bersiaplah untuk menjawab pertanyaan tentang rutinitas, kemampuan, dan pengalaman Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to your speaking practice. Let's talk about your daily life. What time do you usually wake up in the morning?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I usually wake up at 6 o'clock.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's early! Good for you. Can you cook breakfast?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I can cook simple breakfast like eggs and toast.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Tell me about your family. Do you have any brothers or sisters?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have one brother and one sister.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Nice! Where were you yesterday afternoon?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I was at the library with my friends. We studied English together.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'Hi, my name is Sarah. I'm from Canada. I'm a teacher at a primary school in Jakarta. Every morning, I wake up at 5:30 and have breakfast with my family. I can speak English and a little Indonesian.' - Where is Sarah from?
quiz.explanation: Dalam audio, Sarah mengatakan 'I'm from Canada' yang berarti dia berasal dari Kanada. Dengarkan baik-baik informasi tentang asal negara pembicara.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'Yesterday was Sunday. Tom was at the park with his brother. They were very happy. They played football from 9 o'clock to 11 o'clock in the morning.' - What time did Tom play football?
quiz.explanation: Audio menyebutkan 'They played football from 9 o'clock to 11 o'clock' yang berarti mereka bermain sepak bola dari jam 9 sampai jam 11.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'Maria can't drive a car, but she can ride a bicycle very well. She goes to work by bicycle every day. Her office is near the city hospital.' - What can Maria do?
quiz.explanation: Maria mengatakan 'she can ride a bicycle very well' yang berarti dia bisa mengendarai sepeda dengan baik. Kata 'can' menunjukkan kemampuan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'My cousin John is American. He's 25 years old. He's a chef at an Italian restaurant in Bali. He can cook delicious pasta and pizza. His restaurant is very popular.' - What is John's job?
quiz.explanation: John disebutkan sebagai 'a chef at an Italian restaurant' yang berarti dia adalah seorang koki di restoran Italia. Perhatikan informasi tentang pekerjaan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My name is Rina. I'm Indonesian. I live in Bandung with my parents and my younger brother. Every morning, I wake up at 6 o'clock. I have breakfast at 6:30. I usually eat rice and eggs. My brother drinks milk and eats bread. We go to school at 7 o'clock.' - What does Rina eat for breakfast?
quiz.explanation: Teks menjelaskan 'I usually eat rice and eggs' yang berarti Rina biasanya makan nasi dan telur untuk sarapan. Perhatikan subjek kalimat (I vs my brother).

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Last Saturday, my family was at the beach. The weather was sunny and beautiful. My father and I were swimming in the sea. My mother was reading a book. My sister was playing with sand. We were very happy.' - Where was the family last Saturday?
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama menyatakan 'my family was at the beach' yang berarti keluarga mereka berada di pantai. Kata 'was' menunjukkan past tense.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'There is a new supermarket near my house. It opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m. every day. You can buy fresh vegetables, fruits, meat, and drinks there. There is also a small café inside. The café is on the second floor. I go there every Sunday morning.' - What time does the supermarket open?
quiz.explanation: Teks mengatakan 'It opens at 8 a.m.' yang berarti supermarket buka pada pukul 8 pagi. Perhatikan informasi waktu dengan teliti.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My best friend's name is David. He's British. He's a student at the University of Indonesia. He can speak English, Indonesian, and a little Japanese. He studies Indonesian culture. His hobby is playing guitar. He lives in a small apartment near the campus.' - How many languages can David speak?
quiz.explanation: David bisa berbicara 'English, Indonesian, and a little Japanese' yang berarti tiga bahasa. Hitung semua bahasa yang disebutkan meskipun salah satunya hanya sedikit.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct sentence with proper grammar:
quiz.explanation: Untuk subjek 'she' dengan keterangan waktu lampau 'yesterday', gunakan 'was' bukan 'were' atau 'is'. Bentuk past tense dari to be untuk she/he/it adalah 'was'.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence correctly: My brother ___ cook very well. He makes delicious food.
quiz.explanation: Konteks kalimat menunjukkan kemampuan positif karena ada kalimat penjelas 'He makes delicious food', jadi gunakan 'can' untuk menyatakan kemampuan.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I am from Indonesia and my friend are from Japan
I am from Indonesia and my friend is from Japan
I is from Indonesia and my friend is from Japan
quiz.answer: I am from Indonesia and my friend is from Japan
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'am' untuk subjek 'I' dan 'is' untuk subjek tunggal 'my friend'. Jangan campurkan to be yang berbeda untuk subjek yang berbeda.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Put the words in correct order: 'supermarket / go / I / every / to / Saturday / the'
options: I go to the supermarket every Saturday
Every Saturday I to the supermarket go
I every Saturday go to the supermarket
quiz.answer: I go to the supermarket every Saturday
quiz.explanation: Urutan yang benar dalam simple present adalah: Subject + Verb + Object + Time. Pola dasarnya adalah I go to the supermarket (kemana) every Saturday (kapan).

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone asks: 'What's your nationality?' - What is the most appropriate response?
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan tentang 'nationality' (kebangsaan) dijawab dengan nama kebangsaan seperti Indonesian, not nama kota atau umur. 'I'm Indonesian' adalah jawaban yang tepat dan natural.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your friend says: 'Can you play the piano?' and you cannot play it. What should you say?
options: Yes, I can play very well
No, I can't, but I can play guitar
quiz.answer: No, I can't, but I can play guitar
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang paling sopan dan komunikatif adalah mengakui ketidakmampuan dengan 'No, I can't' kemudian menambahkan informasi positif. Ini lebih natural dalam percakapan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone greets you: 'Good morning! How are you today?' - What is the best polite response?
options: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
quiz.answer: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
quiz.explanation: Respons yang sopan untuk greeting 'How are you?' adalah menjawab kondisi Anda, berterima kasih, dan menanyakan balik. 'I'm fine, thank you. And you?' adalah respons paling natural dan sopan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] At a restaurant, the waiter asks: 'What would you like to drink?' - Choose the most appropriate response:
options: I would like orange juice, please
quiz.answer: I would like orange juice, please
quiz.explanation: Dalam konteks memesan di restoran, gunakan 'I would like...' untuk kesopanan, bukan 'I like' (yang menunjukkan kesukaan umum). Tambahkan 'please' untuk lebih sopan.
